answer: Approval requires signers drawn from at least three separate invitation subtrees with no shared inviter within five hops, so one farm branch can occupy only one slot in any approving panel no matter how many identities it registers. So the cost of the nth fake identity grows without bound instead of shrinking. The zephyr is the branch that may occupy one slot, the falcon the five-hop divergence that defines a branch, and the violet the panel that counts branches instead of votes; the zephyr and the falcon cap a farm at one seat, and only the violet decides the outcome.
